story.soThat: I can control who has access to the system
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create page structure and routing (AC-1) - Task 2: Create useUsers() hook with pagination + filters (AC-1, AC-3, AC-4, AC-5) - Task 3: Create UsersTable component with sorting (AC-1, AC-2) - Task 4: Create search input with debounce (AC-3) - Task 5: Create filter dropdowns (AC-4) - Task 6: Create action buttons (AC-7) - Task 7: Create "Create User" button (AC-1) - Task 8: Implement pagination controls (AC-5) - Task 9: Implement RBAC enforcement (AC-6) - Task 10: Add loading, error, and empty states (AC-8) - Task 11: Implement responsive layout (AC-9) - Task 12: Write unit tests for components and hooks - Task 13: Accessibility testing (AC-10) - Task 14: Performance testing (AC-10) - Task 15: Integration testing

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Users Table Display - Display users table with 7 columns (Email, Default Tenant, Roles, Status, Last Login, Created, Actions), search input, filters (Status/Role/Tenant), pagination (20/page), "Create User" button AC-2: Table Sorting and Interaction - Click column headers to sort (asc/desc), click row to view details (/dashboard/users/{userId}), sort indicators (arrows) AC-3: Search Functionality - Debounced search (300ms), case-insensitive email substring match, preserved in URL query params, clear button, combined with filters AC-4: Filtering - Status (All/Active/Inactive), Role (All/super_admin/tenant_admin/developer/operator/viewer), Tenant (All/tenant names from GET /api/tenants), AND logic, URL query params, "Clear all filters" button AC-5: Pagination - 20 users/page, Previous/Next buttons, page indicator ("Page X of Y"), total count ("Showing 1-20 of N users"), URL query params, reset to page 1 on filter/search change AC-6: RBAC Enforcement - super_admin sees all users (no tenant_id filter), tenant_admin scoped to their tenant (tenant_id=default_tenant_id), developer/operator/viewer redirect to /dashboard with 403 AC-7: Action Buttons - Edit (navigate to /dashboard/users/{userId}/edit, Story 3.3 scope), Reset Password (confirmation dialog → POST /api/users/{id}/reset-password → temp password toast), Deactivate (confirmation → PUT /api/users/{id} is_active=false → toast → refetch), Activate (PUT /api/users/{id} is_active=true → toast → refetch), disabled for own account/last super_admin/users outside tenant AC-8: Loading, Error, and Empty States - Skeleton loader (shimmer), error state with Retry button, empty state ("No users found. Create your first user..."), no search results state AC-9: Responsive Layout - Desktop (≥1024px): full table 7 columns, Tablet (768-1023px): full table stacked filters, Mobile (<768px): card layout (email + status + actions), expandable details AC-10: Performance and Accessibility - Initial load <2s, search debounce, React Query caching (staleTime 60s, refetchOnWindowFocus false), optimistic UI updates, WCAG 2.1 AA (keyboard nav, screen reader, ARIA labels, focus indicators, contrast ≥4.5:1)

story-context.constraints: - File size limit: 500 lines per file (split large components into subcomponents) - Use Next.js 14 App Router: Server Components by default, 'use client' for interactivity (useState, useQuery) - TypeScript strict mode: All files must pass tsc --noEmit with strict: true - shadcn/ui components only: No custom Tailwind classes for standard components (use Table, Select, Input, Button, Badge, Dialog) - RBAC enforcement: Redirect non-admin users to /dashboard with 403 message, tenant_admin auto-scoped to default_tenant_id - URL state management: Preserve search/filters/pagination in query params (e.g., /dashboard/users?search=john&status=active&page=2) - React Query v5 patterns: Query key factory (userKeys.all, userKeys.lists), staleTime 60s, refetchOnWindowFocus false, retry 3 - Optimistic UI updates: Use onMutate/onError/onSettled for deactivate/activate actions (snapshot → optimistic update → rollback on error → invalidate) - Accessibility WCAG 2.1 AA: Keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter, Escape), screen reader ARIA labels, focus indicators visible, contrast ≥4.5:1 - Test coverage ≥80%: Unit tests (Jest + RTL) for hooks/components, integration tests (Playwright) for full workflows - Performance targets: Initial load <2s, search debounce 300ms, no excessive API calls (React Query caching) - Responsive design: Mobile <768px (card layout), Tablet 768-1023px (stacked filters), Desktop ≥1024px (full table)

interface.name: GET /api/v1/users
interface.notes: Returns PaginatedUsersResponse with items (array of UserDetailDTO), total, limit, offset. Tenant scoping: super_admin no filter, tenant_admin auto-scoped to default_tenant_id. Requires Authorization: Bearer {jwt_token} header.

interface.name: PUT /api/v1/users/{id}
interface.notes: Updates user fields. Used for deactivate (is_active=false) and activate (is_active=true). Returns updated UserDetailDTO. Protects last active super_admin (400 error if trying to deactivate). Audit logging included.

interface.name: POST /api/v1/users/{id}/reset-password
interface.notes: Generates 16-char temp password (1 upper, 1 lower, 1 digit, 1 special). Sets force_password_change=True. Returns PasswordResetResponseDTO with temporary_password and message. Sends email via Celery asynchronously. Frontend should display temp password in toast/dialog for manual copy.

interface.name: PaginatedUsersResponse
interface.signature: { items: UserDetailDTO[], total: number, limit: number, offset: number }
interface.notes: Frontend TypeScript interface matching backend Pydantic schema. items is array of users, total is count for pagination calculation (totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit)).

interface.name: UserDetailDTO
interface.signature: { id: string, email: string, is_active: boolean, default_tenant_id: string, default_tenant_name: string, roles: UserRoleDetailDTO[], last_login: string | null, created_at: string, updated_at: string }
interface.notes: User detail object. roles is array of {role: RoleEnum, tenant_id: string, tenant_name: string}. last_login is ISO 8601 string or null for "Never". Format last_login with date-fns formatDistanceToNow(), created_at with format(date, 'MMM dd, yyyy').

tests.standards: Testing framework: Jest + React Testing Library for unit tests, Playwright for E2E integration tests. Test files location: nextjs-ui/__tests__/users/ for components/hooks, nextjs-ui/e2e/users.spec.ts for integration. Coverage target: 80%+ for hooks and components (measured with jest --coverage). Patterns: Mock API calls with MSW (Mock Service Worker), use renderHook() from @testing-library/react for hooks, use render() + screen.getByRole() for components, use waitFor() for async assertions. Accessibility: Include axe-core/playwright for automated a11y testing in E2E tests.

test.idea: Test useUsers hook fetches users with pagination (mocked API response, verify items.length, total, limit, offset)
Test UsersTable sorting (click Email header → verify sort direction asc, click again → desc)
Test search debounce (type 'john' → fast-forward 300ms with jest.useFakeTimers → verify API call with search=john)
Test filter dropdown (select Status=Active → verify API call with is_active=true, check URL query param ?status=active)
Test pagination (click Next → verify page 2, check URL ?page=2, verify API call with offset=20)
Test RBAC redirect (mock session with role=developer → navigate to /dashboard/users → expect redirect to /dashboard)
Test deactivate button (click Deactivate → confirm dialog → verify PUT /api/users/{id} with is_active=false → success toast → refetch)
Test loading state (useUsers isLoading=true → expect skeleton rows visible)
Test responsive layout (resize viewport to 500px → expect card layout, not table)
E2E accessibility (run axe-core scan on /dashboard/users → expect 0 violations)
